>
[Small Speak](/Feats.aspx?ID=5385) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Surki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=789" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 50

</column>

---

You understand the languages of most small insects and can speak to them. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) skill with insects, arthropods, and terrestrial invertebrates. The GM determines which creatures count for this ability.
